script: The color of a star tells you its temperature. Red stars are the coolest, at around 3,000 degrees Celsius. Our Sun is about 5,500 degrees at its surface. Blue stars are the hottest, reaching tens of thousands of degrees. That is the opposite of hot and cold taps, where red means hot. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
